patch_list: Blocks the Ninja/Hydra event tracker and everything it forwards to (Braze, Firebase, Adjust, Facebook), Braze, New Relic, Gemius audience measurement, ACRA crash reports, Adjust, Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics and Performance.
Removes the advertising banners from the home feed, search results, ad pages and job offers, and blocks interstitial ads, in the native and the Flutter screens.
